executive_summary: Both Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js fully satisfy the exact user migration request and all items of the legacy evaluator-definitions.md semantic checklist. Every step (Steps 0 through 4) contains an explicit evaluation_requirements array; all 13 legacy semantic areas are canonically merged into Agents.md with unabbreviated pass/fail criteria; a JSON field-definition glossary with key, value, definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass_criteria, and fail_criteria precedes each step (covering every execution and supervisory field, including nested objects and arrays); all governing rules are formatted as verbose key:value catalog entries with definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass_criteria, fail_criteria, and at least three rule_following and three rule_breaking scenarios specifying criterion_used and status; the procedure dependency chart explicitly maps procedure values to state/messages/store/nextmessage/source-code/commit outputs; external evaluator-definitions.md reads and all evaluation_documents_read tracking keys are eliminated while preserving Step 3 access to evaluation-tests.md; deterministic schema validation in send-to-gemini.js aligns with the canonical schemas without obsolete fields; and supervisory_gate.gate_result strictly governs single-step advancement on PASS and same-step retry on FAIL.

agents_md_reference.requirement: Create evaluation requirements for any step that doesn't have explicit requirements list in the requirements doc. PASS only if no Step 0-4 lacks an explicit evaluation_requirements list.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js extracts the governing step block from Agents.md and supplies it to Gemini for evaluation.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: Every step (Steps 0-4) contains an explicit JSON array named evaluation_requirements within its step definition: Step 0 has 4 requirements (lines 437-442: verbatim user request, bootstrap identity, role/completion integrity, persistence/checkpoint); Step 1 has 3 requirements (lines 486-490: request preservation, identity/traceability, completion/persistence); Step 2 has 3 requirements (lines 533-537: user-stated only, verbatim coverage, integrity/persistence); Step 3 has 6 requirements (lines 609-616: decomposition, plan coverage, prospective UI integrity, all tests evaluated, loop control, integrity/checkpoint); and Step 4 has 5 requirements (lines 660-666: failures first, incomplete second, completed last/evidenced, Step 2 coverage, terminal gate integrity). No step lacks an explicit evaluation_requirements list.

agents_md_reference.requirement: Merge all evaluation definitions into Agents.md. All 13 semantic checklist items must be represented with equivalent pass/fail semantics and no lost subrule or weakened qualifier.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js instructs Gemini that Agents.md is the canonical source for evaluation definitions and pass/fail criteria.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: All 13 checklist items are present in Canonical Evaluation Definitions (lines 8-95) and the Governing Rule Catalog (lines 225-345): (1) user_words (lines 8-15) preserves verbatim text and reference resolution without agent summary; (2) applicable_rules (lines 16-23, 325-345) requires exact sources and distinguishes failure examples from rules; (3) effective_instruction_U (lines 24-31, 225-244) combines user words and rules with source traceability; (4) agent_response_P (lines 32-39) distinguishes intention, attempt, and verified completion; (5) requirement_decomposition (lines 40-47, 245-264) decomposes into instruction types, actor, action, target, and modifiers; (6) modifier_analysis (lines 48-55, 245-264) covers polarity, quantity, set, conditions, sequence, time, and method; (7) source_traceability (lines 28-29, 225-244) preserves sources and interpretation context; (8) exact_satisfaction (lines 56-63, 265-284) requires conjunctive satisfaction without unstated demands; (9) failure_description (lines 64-71, 265-284) requires specific component mismatches and observations; (10) failure_pattern_and_analogy (lines 72-79, 285-304) defines semantic relations over topic similarity; (11) pattern_test_result_semantics (lines 76-78, 286-292) defines true as specific violation and false as non-proof of total compliance; (12) promise_instead_of_execution (lines 80-87, 305-324) forbids future promises for authorized due work; and (13) complete_agreed_work (lines 88-95, 305-324) mandates immediate execution of agreed definitions/assignments. No qualifiers are weakened or lost.

agents_md_reference.requirement: Add a definition glossary with an entry for each return schema field in Agents.md. The glossary should precede the appearance of the step, be formatted in JSON, and include key, value, definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass_criteria, fail_criteria.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js validates every field declared in the glossaries during pre-supervision validation.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: A JSON field definition glossary strictly precedes each step: Step 0 Field Definition Glossary (lines 400-428) covers 18 execution and supervisory fields; Step 1 Field Definition Glossary (lines 452-477) covers 14 fields; Step 2 Field Definition Glossary (lines 500-524) covers 15 fields; Step 3 Field Definition Glossary (lines 547-600) covers 33 execution and supervisory fields, including nested/wildcard array paths (clauses[*].actions, modifier_analysis[*].modifier, test_results[*].question_number, etc.); and Step 4 Field Definition Glossary (lines 626-651) covers 17 fields including failed_actions, not_completed_actions, and completed_actions. Every glossary entry contains key, value, definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass_criteria, and fail_criteria.

agents_md_reference.requirement: All markdown style rules must be converted to key:value style entries with definitions of each rule, verbose rule names, evaluation criteria (definition_of_evaluation), pass criteria, fail criteria, and at least 3 scenario-based examples of rule breaking and 3 of rule following specifying criterion_used and status.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js passes the full Agents.md containing the rule catalog in system instructions.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: All governing rules are structured JSON entries in the Governing Rule Catalog (lines 103-346): return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_execution_and_completion_control_surface (lines 105-124), model_role_separation_and_server_verified_execution_identity_are_mandatory (lines 125-144), chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal_nextmessage_to_gemini_response_handshake (lines 145-164), bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_consistent_run_container_before_step_zero (lines 165-184), every_passed_step_must_have_a_durable_git_checkpoint_before_the_next_step (lines 185-204), gemini_supervisory_gate_must_evaluate_every_terminal_execution_value_without_rewriting_evidence (lines 205-224), effective_instruction_must_be_built_from_exact_user_words_and_applicable_rules_with_source_traceability (lines 225-244), requirements_must_be_decomposed_into_checkable_components_and_every_modifier_must_keep_its_scope (lines 245-264), contract_satisfaction_and_failure_records_must_be_requirement_specific_and_evidence_based (lines 265-284), failure_patterns_and_analogies_must_match_semantic_relationships_not_surface_topics (lines 285-304), authorized_work_due_now_must_be_executed_not_replaced_with_a_future_promise (lines 305-324), and failure_examples_are_evidence_for_evaluation_and_do_not_override_their_governing_requirement_sources (lines 325-345). Each rule defines key, value, definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass_criteria, fail_criteria, and an object scenario_examples with exactly 3 rule_following (status: PASS) and 3 rule_breaking (status: FAIL) scenarios, each citing scenario, criterion_used, and status.

agents_md_reference.requirement: Include a dependency chart describing which values in the procedure map to which decisions and outputs in the message stream file, store file, source code, etc.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js consumes the source_values defined in the dependency chart and writes the corresponding decisions and outputs.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: procedure_dependency_chart (lines 374-394) is a JSON array of 15 mappings covering run_nonce, execution.step, role fields, return_schema_completed, Step 0 user_request, Step 2 stated_requirements, Step 3 plan P, Step 3 UI_output, Step 3 test results, Step 3 Loop_Decision, granular evaluations, gate_result, current_step/remaining_steps, messages.json contents, store.json records, and Git commit checkpoints. Each item provides source_value, decision, outputs, and source_code_consumer.

agents_md_reference.requirement: The requirements to read external eval definition must be discarded once eval definition and pass fail criteria are merged into Agents.md and any key value inputs tracking those reads must be eliminated.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js does not import or read evaluator-definitions.md; contextFiles(step) excludes it; controlFailures does not validate evaluation_documents_read; prompts and repair branches explicitly prohibit adding evaluation_documents_read.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: External evaluator-definitions.md is no longer required or referenced anywhere in active schemas. No schema in Agents.md contains evaluation_documents_read. In send-to-gemini.js, evaluator-definitions.md is not read, contextFiles(step) points only to Agents.md (and evaluation-tests.md for Step 3), and prompts explicitly forbid emitting evaluation_documents_read.

agents_md_reference.requirement: All deterministic validation of procedure schema must be updated to match current Step 0-4 return schemas and supervisory envelope without requiring removed fields or permitting omitted required fields.

program_reference.behavior: Deterministic validation strictly checks role fields, return_schema_completed, Step 0 start_of_turn, Step 1 step_1_record, Step 2 step_2_record, Step 3 Step_3 (including A-G and nested arrays), Step 4 Step_4, and the supervisory granular *_eval envelope.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: send-to-gemini.js validates each execution candidate in validateStep (lines 211-370) and controlFailures (lines 186-201) against the exact canonical schemas in Agents.md. It does not look for evaluation_documents_read or any other obsolete fields, checks all required keys and array elements, validates types, and validates the supervisory envelope via evalShape/evalValid (lines 549-603).

agents_md_reference.requirement: Step 3 must retain access to evaluation-tests.md / Step3_TSR without reintroducing evaluator-definition read tracking.

program_reference.behavior: evaluation-tests.md is read from disk and injected into system instruction for Step 3 only, with explicit reminder that evaluation definitions reside in Agents.md and evaluation_documents_read is eliminated.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: Step 3 accesses evaluation-tests.md as its test corpus via send-to-gemini.js lines 7, 61-63, and 474-480 without tracking reads or introducing evaluation_documents_read, satisfying Agents.md lines 681-682.

agents_md_reference.requirement: supervisory_gate.gate_result is the exact transition key; FAIL repeats the same step; PASS advances exactly one step after persistence/checkpoint; terminal completion occurs only after final PASS.

program_reference.behavior: send-to-gemini.js parses supervisory_gate.gate_result for PASS or FAIL. On FAIL, preserves current_step to force same-step retry; on PASS, advances current_step to the next uncompleted step. Marks complete only when remaining_steps is empty.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: The runtime strictly inspects supervisory_gate.gate_result. If FAIL, lines 788-798 set current_step = step, remaining_steps unchanged, awaiting = supervisory_gate_fail, and logs last_supervisory_failure. If PASS, lines 779-787 append step to completed_steps and advance current_step by exactly one step. Status becomes 'complete' only when procedure.current_step is null and all steps are finished.

transition_evaluation.explanation: The transition key supervisory_gate.gate_result is enforced without fallback aliases. Execution output is passed unevaluated to Gemini via gateTemplate. Missing or malformed keys are repaired in a dedicated loop (supervise lines 636-688) without modifying execution records. FAIL retains the current step for retry, and PASS advances the procedure by exactly one step.
